title: Morning Brief — Monday, 19 October 2026
description: Australian agricultural exports hit a record $81.4 billion with China as the dominant market, Queensland's budget allocates $247M for 25,000 extra elective surgeries, and the Gold Coast's unemployment rate sits at a low 3.1% amid strong business formation. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
